A '''fortress''' was built in the jungles of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] around [[2000 BBY/Legends|2000 BBY]] by a band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who used it to store the treasure they had amassed in their travels. It imitated the style of the [[temple]]s built by the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] nearly [[5000 BBY/Legends|three millennia]] earlier.
